mergePrevention.argusJules: No reachable Argus or Jules execution path performs a GitHub merge. Worktree routing relies on strict branch manipulation or recovery via git logic that never issues a git merge.
mergePrevention.milestoneE: Repeated Milestone E reconciliation does not merge, confirmed by inspecting argus autonomy flow.
mergePrevention.legacyRecovery: Unknown merge-intent never retries. Any git states like rebase-merge/head-name are read-only and aborted if needed.
mergePrevention.humanMerges: Human merges are observed using authoritative GitHub state (e.g. state: merged from list-prs).
mergePrevention.staleSha: Stale SHA mismatches fail closed across API and agent validations.
mergePrevention.deployment: Deployment remains disabled pending human authorization.
mergePrevention.importedProjects: Imported projects remain paused until authorized.
mergePrevention.bypass: No alternate workflow, credential or agent-generated command can bypass the human-only merge policy.

hfProvenance.dockerBuild: The Docker build process correctly takes BUILD_GIT_SHA and BUILD_TIMESTAMP build-args. scripts/generate-provenance.sh parses these or uses local git, storing results in /app/apps/server/dist/assets/build-provenance.json.
hfProvenance.healthEndpoint: /api/health calls lib/build-identity.ts, which correctly loads build-provenance.json and exposes gitSha/sourceIdentity in its unauthenticated root response.
hfProvenance.verification: The running artifact can be validated against the approved PR SHA by checking /api/health -> .build.gitSha.
